High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The instant bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of accused-petitioner Pooran Prakash Son Of Shri Jassuram Arora.

The petitioner was arrested in connection with FIR No.536/2013, OP ACB INT, Jaipur registered at Police Station Pradhan Arakshi Kendra, Anti Corruption Bureau, Jaipur for the offence(s) under Sections 7, 8, 9, 10, 12,
13(1)(d)(2), 13(2) and 14 of the Prevention of Corruption Act and Sections 213, 214, 217 and 120B of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the accused-petitioner submits that the petitioner is 65 years of age and is not keeping good health in pursuation to FIR dated 07.12.2013 lodge against him.

Against him and the co-accused same proceedings were initiated under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and the victim in question/public servant in question came to serve the (2 of 2) [CRLMB-9156/2022]
summons/other documents.
The allegations against the petitioner is that he offered bribe to avoid the said service.
The petitioner is not a public servant and the matter pertains to the year 2013.
It is also submitted by the petitioner that the petitioner surrendered and cooperated in investigation before the concerned Court.
It is also submitted that the petitioner is not having any other antecedents except for under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, which is 9 years old.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that the petitioner has offered to bribe the victim/public servant and therefore, the provisions of Prevention Pooran Prakash Son Of Shri Jassuram ... vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 June, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91621947/
1 of Corruption Act are squarely applicable.
4.

entities.text: Prevention Pooran Prakash Son Of Shri Jassuram ... vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 June, 2022 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case as also the fact that the petitioner is 65 years of age and suffering from old aged diseases, cooperating in investigation and perusing the material on record but without commenting on merits/de-merits of the case, this court deems it proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

5. Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that accused-petitioner Pooran Prakash Son Of Shri Jassuram Arora shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(SAMEER JAIN ( V.J.)) Arun/60 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
